implementation_findings.finding: validate verifies structure and literal provenance only; semantic entailment and question completeness unverified. This is acknowledged by docstring, must not be sold as semantic hallucination prevention.
Multi-part question completeness not ensured: D01/D02 omit requested aspects though evidence contains them. Both label answered.
Schema enum includes headings and wrapped-line fragments. Current D04 selects prefixes without operative created:false/conflict clauses and unrelated version_mismatch. Enum does not imply entailment.
Answerability calibration remains max-score binary separation, not retrieval evidence coverage/semantic quality. Dev tuning metrics cannot replace held-out golden semantic assessment.
Pruning compares to profile context; complete enforces min(profile context,runtime n_ctx). Smaller runtime could cause avoidable context_limit.
Retrieval uses latest literal question (topic-prefixed), not dialogue-aware rewritten question. Referential follow-ups not covered by dev evaluation.

resolved_findings.finding: RAG constructor now checks calibrated index_generation against loaded index and fails retrieval_calibration_drift.
